'''Wylenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where she was researching the behavior patterns of [[rakghoul]]s.
